title: 5.3.18 Reading: Four knobs: mass, gravityScale, rotationLock, debug
description: Four knobs that belong to one sprite. A heavier body moves less under the same push, but falls at the same speed. gravityScale is a sprite's own share of gravity (0 floats, 0.5 drifts). rotationLock = true stops a body from turning. debug = true draws the collider, the body moSHion really uses, for finding bugs. Read before 5.3.19 Lab: Nudge the table.
